# `aitbc operations ai cancel`

Cancel an AI job by its ID.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations ai cancel [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--job-id` | text | — | no | Specific job ID |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations ai cancel
```
